extraction.text:
VIDYA SRI PATNAYAKUNI SAP EWM Consultant

pvidyasri27@gmail.com

Bengaluru, India 7893337100

Summary

I am an experienced SAP EWM Consultant with over 3+ years of expertise in implementing, configuring, and supporting SAP Extended Warehouse Management and Logistics Execution modules. I specialize in optimizing warehouse operations, improving supply chain efficiency, and integrating with third-party applications. My skills include resolving production support issues and collaborating with clients to implement process improvements

Experience

Accenture Solutions Pvt.Ltd SAP EWM Consultant

Bengaluru, India

10/2021 - Present

Accenture Solutions is a global professional services company

Provided functional support and resolved issues related to SAP EWM and SAP LE • Took ownership of critical support tickets, including sales orders, inbound/outbound deliveries, STOs, shipments, and HU creation • Resolved complex issues such as stuck queues, MLOR setup, and handling change requests • Coordinated and implemented route codes, transportation zones, and factory calendars to optimize outbound logistics processes • Supported businesses to complete UAT for implementing the change request • Created user documentation for training materials, job aids, and system manuals for end users

Education

GMR INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY B.Tech

India 2016 -2020

Certification

 SAP EWM with SAP S/4 HANA 2020 (C_S4EWM_2020).

Achievements

 Received “Expertise Award” and “Multi-Dimensional Skill Award” Recognition in 2024 for Performance.

 Received “Outstanding Performance Award” Recognition in 2023.

 Received “Core Value Award” and “Best people” Recognition in 2022.

Projects

Project 1 – LION AMS {AUS&NZ client [10/2023 - till date]

 LION S/4 Hana Support Project belongs to Beverage’s sector which serves in AUS and NZ region.

 Managed plant address changes to ensure accurate logistics and warehouse operations.

 Assigned reason codes for movement types to properly categorize and track inventory movements.

 Gained hands-on experience in route code creation to optimize outbound logistics processes.

 Configured transportation zones to improve routing and transportation efficiency.

 Updated factory calendars to ensure accurate scheduling and align with business operations.

 Updated lead times for transportation and warehouse processes to ensure timely deliveries.

 Configured route determination to enhance logistics operations and reduce delays.

 Updated carrier/service agent information to maintain accurate logistics partnerships.

 Provided access for PI tolerance to maintain accurate inventory and logistics controls.

 Managed RF user access, ensuring proper system access for warehouse personnel.

 Resolved issues where PGI (Post Goods Issue) failed due to hard allocated batch constraints.

 Addressed problems related to late optimization that impacted warehouse and logistics efficiency.

 Investigated and resolved issues where the system was not receiving ship and pick confirmation messages from the 3PL (Third-Party Logistics

provider).

 Identified and resolved cases of duplicate Trip IDs, preventing delays in transportation management.

 Identified duplicate bond items in OBD which fails to PGI the delivery.

 Managed and resolved priority tickets across various processes, including sales orders, inbound/outbound deliveries, STO, shipment handling,

and MLOR setup.

 Coordinated and ensured Mass Completion of ghost pallet reversals, resolving complex issues related to the Minimum Shelf Life (MLOR) setup

for materials.

 Resolved stuck queues generated during the day, minimizing operational disruptions.

 Supported critical tasks related to sales order management, STO setups, and MLOR configurations, ensuring smooth operations.

 Incidents, Problems and Service request resolutions adhering to SLA.

Project 2 – Linfox {AUS, NZ} [12/2021 – 09/2023]

 Linfox is Australia's largest privately-owned logistics company, providing integrated supply chain solutions across the Asia Pacific region.

 Acted as a key SAP EWM consultant, supporting warehouse operations and enhancing efficiency for Linfox.

 Managed and resolved stuck queues, including resolving issues with HU stuck on resources, and retriggered orders through WebMethods.

 Contributed to the outbound processes, ensuring effective goods issue, picking, loading, and shipping operations in line with company

standards.

 Played a vital role in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for implementing process and system changes.

 Handled critical tickets related to warehouse management processes such as sales orders, inbound/outbound deliveries, STOs, and shipments.

 Supported SAP EWM integration with other modules and third-party systems for seamless operation.
